# C99 database client profile. libdrizzle-redux is evaluated and excluded: C++ core.
set(_db_vendor "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(_hiredis_sources alloc.c async.c hiredis.c net.c read.c sds.c sockcompat.c)
list(TRANSFORM _hiredis_sources PREPEND "${_db_vendor}/hiredis/")
add_library(lmx_db_hiredis STATIC ${_hiredis_sources})
lmx_c99_target(lmx_db_hiredis)
target_include_directories(lmx_db_hiredis PUBLIC "${_db_vendor}/hiredis")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_db_hiredis PRIVATE _DEFAULT_SOURCE=1)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_db_hiredis PUBLIC ws2_32 crypt32)
endif()
add_library(LMX::hiredis ALIAS lmx_db_hiredis)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/MongoC.cmake")
add_library(lmx_databases INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(lmx_databases INTERFACE LMX::hiredis LMX::mongoc LMX::bson)
lmx_c99_target(lmx_databases)
add_library(LMX::databases ALIAS lmx_databases)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    foreach(_name IN ITEMS bson mongoc combined)
        add_executable(lmx_db_test_${_name} tests/${_name}.c)
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_db_test_${_name})
        if(_name STREQUAL "bson")
            target_link_libraries(lmx_db_test_${_name} PRIVATE LMX::bson)
        else()
            target_link_libraries(lmx_db_test_${_name} PRIVATE LMX::databases)
        endif()
        add_test(NAME databases_${_name} COMMAND lmx_db_test_${_name})
        set_tests_properties(databases_${_name} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 10)
    endforeach()
    if(UNIX)
        add_executable(lmx_db_test_hiredis tests/hiredis.c)
        lmx_c99_target(lmx_db_test_hiredis)
        target_compile_definitions(lmx_db_test_hiredis PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
        target_link_libraries(lmx_db_test_hiredis PRIVATE LMX::hiredis Threads::Threads)
        add_test(NAME databases_hiredis COMMAND lmx_db_test_hiredis)
        set_tests_properties(databases_hiredis PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 10)
    endif()
endif()
